privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Khmer News, we respect your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
privacy.h1_body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name and email when you subscribe to our newsletter or contact us. We also collect anonymous usage data such as page views and browser type to improve our services.
privacy.h2_body: We use your information to deliver news updates you request, respond to your inquiries, and improve our website experience. We never sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.h3_body: We use cookies to remember your language preference and site settings. You can disable cookies in your browser at any time.
privacy.h4_body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us via our contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing and using Khmer News, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
terms.h1_body: All articles, images, and content published on Khmer News are protected by copyright. You may share our content with proper attribution, but republishing without permission is prohibited.
terms.h2_body: You agree not to use this website for any unlawful purpose or to post content that is defamatory, offensive, or infringes on the rights of others.
terms.h3_body: Khmer News displays third-party advertisements. We are not responsible for the content of external advertisers or linked websites.
terms.h4_body: Khmer News provides news content on an 'as is' basis. We are not liable for any errors or omissions in the content, or for any losses arising from the use of this website.
